title: feedback: leave feedback from inside the app (command, entry, feedback.jsonl), with slinger feedback add/ls/resolve/path
description: Owner request 2026-11-11: 'There should be a leave feedback feature, like Flick has, so I don't have to leave the application for it.' Model: Flick's feedback module (its docs/feedback.md): one JSON line per note appended to feedback.jsonl, never rewritten; resolving appends a line. In slinger: a leave-feedback command in the registry (so it shows in the key overlay, the palette and the Help menu), which opens a one-line entry in the focused pane; return saves, escape cancels; a flash confirms. Each line: ts (local time with offset), text, build, and what the app was showing (workspace, canvas, page, tool; selected count when any). A verb through core -> control -> daemon -> CLI and app. CLI: slinger feedback add <text> | ls [--all] [--limit n] | resolve <ts> [note] | path, text by default and --json.
